title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Belmont University, from the historic recording studios of Music Row to the trendy boutiques of 12 South.

cards.title: Bongo Java
cards.subtitle: Belmont Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Nashville's oldest coffeehouse for a local brew. It is a staple for students and faculty located directly across from the university's main entrance.
cards.short_summary: A historic coffeehouse and student hub located on the Belmont Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Bongo Java is a walkable, crowd-favorite coffee shop right across from Belmont University on Belmont Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | L. Gregory Jones - President of Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for walk-in service; outdoor seating available.

cards.title: Sevier Park
cards.subtitle: 12 South District
cards.notes: Walk through this 20-acre green space featuring a community center and walking trails. It serves as the southern anchor of the popular 12 South shopping district.
cards.short_summary: A large public park and community hub at the southern end of the 12 South district.
cards.evidence_claim: Sevier Park borders the 12 South neighborhood to the south and features walking trails and a community center.
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk; free admission.

cards.title: Belcourt Theatre
cards.subtitle: Hillsboro Village Corridor
cards.notes: Catch an independent or classic film at this historic non-profit cinema. It has been a cultural landmark in Hillsboro Village since 1925.
cards.short_summary: A historic independent cinema located in the Hillsboro Village shopping district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Belcourt Theatre is a nearby cultural attraction in Hillsboro Village offering a range of classic and independent films.
cards.source_title: Belmont & Hillsboro Village Neighborhoods | Visit Nashville TN
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled screenings; tickets can be purchased online or at the box office.

cards.title: RCA Studio B
cards.subtitle: Music Row District
cards.notes: Tour the legendary studio where Elvis Presley and Dolly Parton recorded hits. It is a cornerstone of the historic Music Row district near campus.
cards.short_summary: A historic recording studio and museum located in the heart of Music Row.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic RCA Studio B is a notable location on Music Row where legendary artists like Elvis Presley recorded many hits.
cards.access_notes: Tours are available by appointment; tickets are required for entry.

cards.title: Edgehill Village
cards.subtitle: Villa Place Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this micro-district featuring boutiques and eateries like Bella Napoli. It is a small but vibrant commercial pocket just north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A boutique commercial district located on Villa Place in the Edgehill neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Edgehill Village is a quaint neighborhood with popular spots for students, including shops and restaurants on Villa Place.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible commercial area; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: The Pancake Pantry
cards.subtitle: 21st Avenue South Corridor
cards.notes: Join the line at this Nashville institution for scratch-made pancakes. It is a landmark destination on the 21st Avenue corridor near Hillsboro Village.
cards.short_summary: A famous breakfast restaurant located on the 21st Avenue South corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pancake Pantry is a Nashville staple located along 21st Avenue South, just west of the Belmont campus.
cards.source_title: 8 Best Neighborhoods Near Belmont University in Nashville
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast and lunch; expect wait times on weekends.

cards.title: Acklen Avenue
cards.subtitle: Acklen Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this residential and commercial street that connects Belmont to Hillsboro Village. It features local favorites like Dose Coffee and student housing.
cards.short_summary: A key connector street between Belmont University and the Hillsboro Village district.
cards.evidence_claim: Acklen Avenue is a neighborhood corridor near Belmont University featuring restaurants like Dose Coffee and residential units.
cards.source_title: Apartments near Belmont University | 2100 Acklen Flats | Map
cards.access_notes: Public city street; walkable from the Belmont campus.

cards.title: Wedgewood-Houston
cards.subtitle: Wedgewood Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this industrial-turned-arts district for gallery crawls and creative spaces. It is located just east of the university along Wedgewood Avenue.
cards.short_summary: An artistic and creative district located along the Wedgewood Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wedgewood-Houston is an artistic hub in Nashville featuring art galleries and creative businesses like Elegy Coffee.
cards.source_title: Welcome To Wedgewood-Houston: An Artistic Hub In Nashville, TN
cards.access_notes: Public district; hosts the 'Arts & Music at Wedgewood-Houston' crawl on the first Saturday of each month.

cards.title: Frothy Monkey
cards.subtitle: 12 South Corridor
cards.notes: Dine at the original location of this local coffeehouse chain. It is a central meeting spot for the 12 South neighborhood's residents and visitors.
cards.short_summary: A popular local coffeehouse and restaurant in the 12 South district.
cards.evidence_claim: Frothy Monkey's original location is a standout place in the 12 South neighborhood.
cards.source_title: 12 South in Nashville - Restaurants and Things to Do
cards.access_notes: Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

cards.title: International Market
cards.subtitle: Belmont Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic Thai cuisine at this James Beard-recognized restaurant. It has served the Belmont community since 1975 from its location on Belmont Blvd.
cards.short_summary: A historic Thai restaurant and market located on the Belmont Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: International Market & Restaurant has fed generations of Belmont University students since 1975 and is located on Belmont Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; closed on certain holidays.
